title: Coordinated radio measurements before flying scanners
design_lesson: Spatially deliberate measurements matter more than simply adding a drone. Separate measurement geometry from transport networking.
proposed_first_experiment: Replay a known synthetic target over alternative permitted sample positions. Compare fixed and adaptive selection without flying.
metrics: Reconstruction error, coverage, number of observations, calibration sensitivity.
limits: Do not present the study as an instant stock-phone room scanner.

title: Edges from diffraction, not a generative picture
design_lesson: A physics-based feature can support a narrower, more defensible output than a photorealistic scene.
proposed_first_experiment: Define known edge targets and evaluate algorithm behavior on held-out synthetic geometry before any approved scanning fixture.
metrics: Edge localization, missed/false edges and uncertainty under noisy observations.
limits: Letter-shaped target recovery does not establish reading arbitrary documents.

title: Radio pose and cross-modal supervision
design_lesson: Training supervision and deployment observations can differ; collect ground truth carefully and test domain shift.
proposed_first_experiment: Use licensed public/synthetic data to compare presence/localization with pose hypotheses; avoid real subject identification.
metrics: Held-out subject/session error, ambiguity and abstention.
limits: Pose estimates are not identity, medical diagnosis or generic WiFi support.

title: Low-cost CSI acquisition as a useful bridge
design_lesson: Acquisition metadata and reproducible fixtures are reusable even if the later reconstruction method changes.
proposed_first_experiment: Design a permitted node/fixture dataset with separate stationary/no-motion and moved-environment sessions.
metrics: False alarms per hour, missed-presence cases, sensor drift and setup repeatability.
limits: Standard publication and example code are not hardware compatibility or Haven accuracy.

title: Complementary sensing in degraded spaces
design_lesson: Different sensors fail differently; fusion should expose degraded modes rather than average them into false confidence.
proposed_first_experiment: Replay recorded/synthetic visual, depth and motion streams with one corrupted modality at a time.
metrics: Localization error versus best single modality; time to flag degradation.
limits: No simulated smoke or missing camera should be treated as qualified real-fire navigation.

title: Mobile manipulation learned from demonstration
design_lesson: Human-mediated demonstration can be a bridge between teleoperation and a bounded learned skill.
proposed_first_experiment: Plan a light inert-object transfer on a supervised bench with held-out starting positions.
metrics: Success across variations, manual interventions, dropped/ambiguous outcomes.
limits: Do not copy hot/sharp demonstration tasks into an unqualified home robot.

title: Printed arm components with explicit calibration
design_lesson: Fabrication is only one part of robotics; assembly, actuators and calibration need their own evidence.
proposed_first_experiment: Create a BOM and calibration protocol for a non-actuated mock fixture before deciding on a complete arm.
metrics: Dimensional fit, assembly repeatability and calibration traceability.
limits: A printable design is not a finished robot or a force-safe device.

title: A rover as a movable sensor/communications station
design_lesson: A grounded carrier may answer the practical question without aerial energy or flight integration.
proposed_first_experiment: Design a teleoperated path between marked observation positions; first run the adapter on recorded data.
metrics: Pose/arrival truth, acquisition repeatability, stop behavior and task usefulness.
limits: Do not presume autonomous household navigation from platform assembly instructions.

title: Open visual-action policies and embodiment gaps
design_lesson: A model checkpoint is meaningful only with matching sensors, action space, calibration and resources.
proposed_first_experiment: Perform a paper interface/resource review and offline action-schema sanity checks with synthetic observations.
metrics: Adapter mismatch detection, required data and actual resource feasibility.
limits: System RAM is not GPU memory; no checkpoint is assumed qualified on Eric's hardware.

title: Emerging local robot intelligence with access limits
design_lesson: Track capable models without making unavailable products prerequisites.
proposed_first_experiment: Create a capability/API/access watch card and a provider-neutral proposal contract; no installation.
metrics: Documented access and a realistic future qualification plan.
limits: Trusted-tester access is not general availability.

title: Learning in simulation and validating reality
design_lesson: A strong specialized result motivates transfer testing, not a blanket claim of safe autonomy.
proposed_first_experiment: Test sensitivity to dynamics and latency mismatch in the existing approved simulator only after that milestone is authorized.
metrics: Policy robustness under modeled mismatch and explicit applicability limits.
limits: Do not pursue racing speed or transplant policies into real rescue flight.

title: Generative mechanical design with requirements
design_lesson: Encode attachment surfaces, keep-outs and loads before optimizing shape. Preserve independent engineering checks.
proposed_first_experiment: Generate alternative low-risk sensor stands against a fixed interface and dimensional constraint set.
metrics: Constraint violations, material use, fit and measured repeatability.
limits: A generated shape or simulation is not structural qualification.

title: Autonomous lab loops and scientific correction
design_lesson: Closed loops need protected metrics, independent observation and retained failed trials; impressive novelty claims can require correction.
proposed_first_experiment: Use a benign fixture optimization campaign with an evaluator the proposing agent cannot edit.
metrics: Verified improvement versus baseline, trial accounting and disagreement handling.
limits: No chemistry replication or extrapolation of discovery claims into guaranteed engineering autonomy.

title: Drone AED delivery as a whole response chain
design_lesson: Useful delivery depends on eligibility, arrival, access, human understanding and communication—not flight speed alone.
proposed_first_experiment: Simulate a dummy-kit request and human acknowledgement; model unavailability, inaccessible destination and late arrival.
metrics: Time to understandable information/access; failed handoffs and independent-help continuity.
limits: No claim of survival benefit for Haven, treatment advice or real dispatch authority.

title: Illumination and voice as useful payload categories
design_lesson: Power/mass/thermal and human factors belong in the capability contract. Ground testing can answer value first.
proposed_first_experiment: Plan a bounded ground light-angle and spoken-message experiment in an authorized area.
metrics: Image usefulness, glare, intelligibility, energy and heating.
limits: The documented enterprise accessories do not fit every consumer aircraft.

title: Off-grid short messages
design_lesson: Small truthful messages may have more utility than pretending to provide unavailable broadband.
proposed_first_experiment: Use synthetic messages over a mocked contact schedule, then a separately approved node test.
metrics: Deduplication, expiry, delivery state, energy and privacy exposure.
limits: No universal radio range or emergency-response guarantee.

title: Store-and-forward mobility
design_lesson: A useful communication task may tolerate delay; make the delay and recipient acknowledgement explicit.
proposed_first_experiment: Compare stationary relay and data-ferry contact schedules in a simulator with loss/duplicates.
metrics: Delivery probability within deadline, delay and resource cost.
limits: Do not equate receipt by a mobile relay with responder dispatch.

title: Direct room scans as honest spatial ground truth
design_lesson: Known direct-view geometry can support calibration and later comparison without claiming it is a live through-wall observation.
proposed_first_experiment: Use consented/synthetic room geometry to test map-origin/time labels and transforms.
metrics: Geometry consistency, transform uncertainty and historical/live distinction.
limits: Supported LiDAR hardware is required for that API; not every iPhone is assumed compatible.

title: Glasses as a requested observation interface
design_lesson: Separate display/audio/camera inputs and production availability before designing an experience around them.
proposed_first_experiment: Mock wearer capture and private output; inventory exact supported hardware later.
metrics: Capture state, wearer identity, origin timestamp and permission revocation.
limits: Mock success and preview documentation are not real-device production qualification.

title: Personal-agent framework versus owned coordinator
design_lesson: Compare context/tool overhead, privacy and maintainability separately from model quality.
proposed_first_experiment: Use the same small synthetic task set and limited capabilities in a framework evaluation and thin-coordinator design.
metrics: Grounded success, context growth, cost, isolation and unapproved skill changes.
limits: Open agent code does not provide free inference or make a hosted product self-hostable.

title: Compact models and separate speech components
design_lesson: Separate ordinary code, small-model tasks and strong reasoning; measure the entire interaction.
proposed_first_experiment: Benchmark short sourced questions, structured intent and speech fixtures under bounded context.
metrics: Latency, grounding, schema validity, memory, cost and privacy errors.
limits: Model artifact size and schema validity do not prove runtime fit or correctness.

title: A printer gateway is an actuator, not a chat tool
design_lesson: Connect exact design/toolpath/profile versions through a separate approved machine job and inspection pipeline.
proposed_first_experiment: Validate inert job manifests with changed hashes and interrupted states; no hardware execution.
metrics: Rejection of unreviewed jobs, correct incomplete/inspection states and provenance.
limits: No automatic heater operation or safety guarantee from a camera.
